subject: Final dunning + exec touchpoint requested — Outstanding invoices & VAT evidence (Royal Harbor)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: finance@royalharbor.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Outstanding invoices (INV-2028-04-789, INV-2028-03-744) + VAT evidence request

Hi Daniel / Royal Harbor finance team,

Following up on the unpaid invoices listed above — total outstanding €187,450 (net). Per our records these invoices are 62 and 39 days past due respectively. We have not received remittance advice or VAT reverse-charge confirmation for the March invoice, which is blocking reconciliation on both sides.

I've attached the invoices and the original PO we received (RoyalHarbor_PO_88922.pdf). Can you please:
- Confirm whether Royal Harbor will remit the full amount or a partial payment this week
- Provide the VAT treatment you are applying (reverse-charge certificate or local VAT remittance evidence)
- If PO mismatch is the blocking item, confirm the exact lines to reissue on our side

If you need a short payment schedule we can accept a two-part settlement: 50% on receipt, remaining 50% within 14 days. If we don't receive a firm plan by EOD Thursday (Apr 12) we will escalate to collections and consider a temporary credit hold per our collections policy.

Attachments: INV-2028-04-789.pdf (invoice), INV-2028-03-744.pdf (invoice), RoyalHarbor_PO_88922.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Accounts Receivable Manager
Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com
+44 20 7946 0112

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@royalharbor.com>

Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 14:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Outstanding invoices (INV-2028-04-789, INV-2028-03-744) + VAT evidence request

Kimberly — thanks for the note.

Short version: we have an internal PO mismatch and our AP system will not pay until the PO lines match invoice lines. Procurement raised this on Apr 5 and asked for a reissued invoice that splits the March line to match their PO (they need the freight line as a separate charge for GL reasons).

Regarding VAT: Royal Harbor is applying the reverse-charge for intra-EU services in our country but procurement is requesting a vendor-signed declaration to attach to their tax packet. If you can reissue an invoice and send a short VAT declaration PDF that confirms no VAT was charged, I can push payment sooner.

We can commit to a 40% remittance this Friday (Apr 13) if the corrected documents arrive by Wed EOD. Otherwise we will need a formal payment plan.

-Daniel
Daniel Park
CFO, Royal Harbor Logistics

Daniel — appreciate the quick reply.

I've attached a reissued invoice that splits freight as a separate line (INV-2028-04-789-R1.pdf) and a one-page VAT declaration template filled out by our tax team (VAT_evidence_packet.zip contains the signed declaration and our EU VAT registration screenshot).

Per your note, Marissa (collections lead) and Jonas (sales director) are looped in so we can align on timing and avoid disruption to production access. If Royal Harbor can complete the 40% payment by Apr 13 as proposed, we will hold off on initiating a credit hold or further dunning steps.

Please confirm once you've received the attachments and we'll await payment confirmation.

Thanks,
Kimberly

Attachments: INV-2028-04-789-R1.pdf, VAT_evidence_packet.zip

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Subject: Final notice before credit hold — Royal Harbor (INV-2028-04-789-R1)

Daniel / Royal Harbor team — copying in the sales lead to ensure exec visibility.

Per Kimberly's thread: we have now provided reissued invoice and VAT evidence. We appreciate the 40% pay commitment but need remittance confirmation by EOD Apr 13 to avoid the following actions:
- Place Royal Harbor on temporary credit hold (suspends billing and may pause access)
- Begin a formal dunning sequence (final notice + collections outreach)
- Escalate to our commercial leadership for approval of any extended payment terms

If there is a requirement for an exec-to-exec call to unblock, Jonas is available Thursday 11:30–13:00 BST or Friday 09:00–11:00 BST. Otherwise please instruct AP to release the 40% remittance and provide the payment reference.

If we do not receive a payment confirmation by Apr 13 17:00 BST we will assume no payment and proceed with credit hold. This is a final notice.

Regards,
Marissa Cole

AP has scheduled a 40% payment of €74,980 to be executed by close of business today. Payment ref: RH-APR13-5743. They still need the signed VAT declaration in the vendor file (we received the ZIP but procurement requires a separate PDF stamped by supplier finance). Marcus from procurement will circulate the required format; I will ask AP to release funds once that is attached to our payment batch.

Jonas — thanks for offering exec time. I think we can avoid an exec call if payment posts and the VAT doc is attached — procurement flagged it as the only outstanding admin item. If payment doesn't post tomorrow we will need to revisit and I appreciate your availability.

-Daniel
